arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Arranged in series by record type. Records remain in original order, as received.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Many records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The RAC possesses legal title in and to the Margaret E. Mahoney papers. The RAC does not own copyright or literary property rights to the collection, but under the terms of the original gift, it has the ability to grant permission to researchers to quote and cite material from the collection in their publications (subject to any necessary third-party permissions).

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The Margaret E. Mahoney papers were transferred to RAC in appropriately 10 separate accessions in the early and mid 2000s, primarily following Mahoney's death in 2007. Records were received from Margaret E. Mahoney, the Commonwealth Fund, and MEM Associates, Inc., as well as the central office of the Healthy Steps for Young Children Program.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Margaret E. Mahoney papers document her professional career in philanthropy administration. The papers include documentation of the Board and Advisory positions she held including but not limited to: MacArthur Foundation, Arthur Ashe Foundation, CDC Foundation, Columbia University, Council on Foundations, Indiana University Center on Philanthropy, and New York Academy of Medicine.

The collection also contains correspondence, chronological files, and project files, many of which originate from her time as head of her consulting firm MEM Associates in the late 1990s and early 2000s. A primary area of focus for MEM was to continue and expand the work of the Healthy Steps for Young Children program, the activities of which is well documented throughout the collection.
The papers also contain select Commonwealth Fund files, most notably Board books, and program and policy files, during Mahoney's service as President of the Fund from 1980-1994.
